translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Doula sivila
Guyau ikaibiga, kawala, “Mina Isireli, kidamwa magimi bukusivilasi, kwaimilavausi baisa yeigu. Kidamwa bukukimadagisi baisa yeigu, e kuligaimwaisi minasina tokolu yeigu nakukologu.
Ibodaimi wala bukukwatotilasi oyagagu. E oluvi boda komwaidona binigadasi mwada bamitukwaii matausina e biyakawolaigusi goli.”
Guyau iluki tomotala Yuda deli Yerusalem, kawala, “Kupulaisi mi bagula, e gala bukusapwaisi kami yagogu oluwalaisi kaigunigwaini.

Kuyamataisi mi kabutu deli yeigu, mi Guyau, e yokomi mina Yuda deli Yerusalem kwabomaimi titoulemi baisa yeigu. Kidamwa gala bukuvagaisi makawala, ulo gibuluwa bikata makawala kova, paila wala kumitugagasi, mapaila bilepa e gala taitala ibodi bikimati.”
Makateki goli tilaula bisuvaisi kulusi bisuvisi Yuda

content.text: Guyau bimai kabomwau deli katudoum metoya opiliyavata.
Makawala laiyoni bima metoya okala lagi,
taitala kala tokodadaimi boda bogwa eisilavi bima.
e biligaim wala kwedidadaimi e gala availa bisiki mavilousina.
paila Guyau la gibuluwa saina tiganini

content: Guyau ikaibiga, kawala, “Yam makwaina gweguya, la tosikwawa, si tuvaluwa bikitumouwaisi, tolula bitutu ninasi, e tovitoubobuta biyowa luposi.”
Mapaila akaibiga, kawagu, “Guyau Towalakaiwa, ka - yoku mokwita lokusepuloki Yerusalem tomotala. Lokulivala mwada vakota, mitaga kema okaiyasi wala.”
Tuta bima, tomotala Yerusalem bilagaisi biga kidamwa yagila kweyuviyavi biuu bima metoya oviloupakala bimakaia matausina. Yagila makwaina gala biuu manum makawala yagila ibodi biyuvisau wawa wala.
Yagila makwaina bima baisa Guyau la karaiwaga saina minimanigaga. Baisa Guyau wala titoulela ikikamituli kasi kamwaga la tomota.
Yuda kala tilaula itoulaisi itopataisi
Kugisi, tilaula leimeimaisi makawala lowalowa. Si waga kaibibiu makawala tigiviviluwa, si wosa saina nagigigibula ikalisauwaisi mluveka. Yakidasi totamwau! Bitadoumlabasi!
Yerusalem, kwatumigileu sula metoya olumoulem, e bukukolaim. Ammakawala kala kaduwonaku bukuninamsi mitugaga ninamsela?
Touwata metoya mapilana Dani e metoya mapilana Koya Epereim ikamitulaisi bulogala gaga.
Bimaisi bikamitilakaisi boda ituwoli ituwoli e bilukwaisi Yerusalem kidamwa tilaula bimaisi metoya valu saina kaduwonaku. Tilaula matausina bikawotaisi bikavilakaisi viluwela Yuda.
E bivaulaisi bivapataisi Yerusalem makawala bagula kala toyamata, paila uula tomotela ikosomapwaisi Guyau. Guyau bogwa leilivala.

Yuda, yoku titoulem wala lokuyomituli kam mwau metoya m bubunela gaga deli paila vavagi makwaisina lokuvagi. M mitugaga iyomituli mmayuyu makwaisina isisu olumoulem. Ka, bogwa leibasaim lokuboda saina mwaugaga olopom.
Yeremaia kala mmayuyu paila la tomota

content.text: Mmayuyu! Gala ibodi balumkoli mmayuyu makawala!
Kabomwau kwaitala bima bim oluvi kwaitala
e valu viloumwaidona iviloudadaimi wala itotu.
Ammakawala kala kaduwonaku kabilia bagigisi wala bititokaia,
Guyau ikaibiga, kawala, “Ulo tomota mina ninagowa
Matausina kasi tovagi wala uvagila mitugaga biuvagaisi

content: Yeremaia igisi kilisala kodadaimi bima

content.text: e mauna nayoyowa makawala wala bogwa goli eibutusi ilosi.

content: (Guyau ikaibiga, kawala, “Valu watanawa komwaidona biviloupakala, mitaga gala paila bikatudidaimisi biwokuva.”)

content.text: Guyau bogwa leilivala, e nanola gala bikatumapu,
avai tuta bilagaisi luluwasi tosisila wosa
e gala availa bisikaili mavilousina tuvaila.
Avaka paila m sikam kwama bweyani?
Avaka paila m sikam kuwa kwaikavikavila, deli kukuma matam?
Alagi valam makawala natana vivila eigigadi bitapoi yamala,
e wakula makawala wala natana vivila kala vigavau eitapoi yamala.
